name: Entwined: The Visual Novel
source:
Entwined is a visual novel horror game set in a hospital. A lockdown has occurred and no one can escape. Team up with either a nurse or a patient in order to escape the hospital. Make your choice for the path ahead…

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4214110]Steam[/url]]
